title: Boric's Task I (miniquest)
start: Speak to Boric in the workshop accessed from the stairs in Doric's hut, just outside the gates of Taverley north of Falador.

recommended.t: Falador Teleport or activated Falador lodestone

steps.t: Head down the stairs behind Doric's hut to speak to Boric. [Chat: 1 Do you have any Mining tasks for me? › Accept]
Head to Seers' Village coal truck mining site, west of McGrubor's Wood.
Deposit 30 coal into the coal truck.

sub.t: It does not need to be mined, it can be purchased off the Grand exchange. Make sure it isn't noted.

steps.t: Talk to the Dwarven Miner to the south. [Chat: 1 Yes.]
